decisions.crosscheck: TCDB confirms 525 original base, 325 Series I+200 Series II, 12 authentic insert families and original Rick Mirer PROMO; 525 individual numbered base records and all 12 named source checklists come from MCB, whose complete groups and source counts were independently corroborated against TCDB pages.
decisions.totals: 650 main collector cards = 525 base + 125 across 12 insert families. Additionally one authentic #1 Rick Mirer parent-set promo = 651 entries and 14 collector ProductSets, not a manufactured 13th insert.
decisions.series: Two independent packs: Series One 14 standard cards vs Series Two 13 standard cards, with Series One #1-325 and Series Two #326-525; jumbos Series One 17 cards vs Series Two 16 cards per TCDB, 36 packs per box. Product-level 14x36 is Series One wax only; released pack engine must handle Series and format restrictions.
decisions.noTeam: Printed physical base #320 NFL 75th Anniversary and #325 Series One insert checklist have no team; these are genuinely teamless non-player records, not missing source data.
decisions.mirer: Mirer non-auto #1-10 were pack issued and #11-12 mail-in exchange ONLY. Autographed counterpart has 8 specific authentic numbers and Fleer embossing, distinct from non-auto.
decisions.rarity: TCDB documents premium Flair cross-brand Series II exclusives, foil-only Touchdown Kings, jumbo-pack-only Ultra Stars, and Hobby case-only 3.5x5 Achievement Awards Jumbo. Never permit these as generic standard pack hits; all product-set odds null until slot-specific collation added.
decisions.rookies: MCB source RC suffix preserved in per-card variant/source annotation, not appended to printed player names.
decisions.noInvented: No fabricated Gold Medallion parallels, autograph subjects beyond eight, serial numbers, pack odds, player teams, pack images or scans.
decisions.release: UNRELEASED DRAFT until authentic scans/images, pack and box art, pricing and precise Series/format/case/mail-in/promo collation is implemented. No changes to existing VCS sets.
